segments.he: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר בֶּן יַעֲקֹב אוֹמֵר: בִּיב הַקָּמוּר.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna that «Rabbi Eliezer ben Ya’akov says:» If the first four cubits of a drainage «ditch were arched over» in the public domain, it is permitted to pour waste water into it on Shabbat. However, the Rabbis say: One may pour water only upon the roof, from which it will spill into the drain of its own accord.
